title: rigid-realizations
description:
This repository studies how many real realizations minimally rigid graphs can reach in the plane and in space.

It claims, pending independent verification, a certificate that all 880 realizations of the 10-vertex graph L880 are real (r_2(10) = c_2(10) = 880).

Committed baseline certificates at Bartzos et al.'s published lengths support r_2 >= 868 in the plane and r_3 >= 132 for G160 in 3D, also pending independent verification.

Directed by Ahraz Arifuddin

Researched and verified by different model families across Gemini, Claude, Grok, OpenAI, and Muse
